summary: Backend tests for WladBot folder-context injection (Iter 92.23.8). All 10 new test cases pass: folder_context_used=true with owned folder, false with no/foreign/non-existent folder, multi-turn injection works, chat session creation auto-stamps folder_id + creates folder_item, foreign folder_id silently ignored on session create, ?folder_id= filter works, regression on 92.23.7 folders intact.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/chat.py:289-356 — `check_and_deduct_credit` is called BEFORE folder context is resolved; if a user mis-types folder_id they still pay a credit even though context wasn't applied. Consider resolving folder context first and using the boolean as a UX hint to user (not blocking). Low-priority polish.

routes/chat.py:257-273 — `_ensure_session` stamps folder_id only on session CREATION; if the same session_id is reused later with a NEW folder_id, the session's folder_id is NOT updated (intentional per comment). However the chat itself still injects the new folder's context — this means session.folder_id can drift from the actually-injected context per turn. OK for now (per code comment) but worth a frontend warning if user switches folders mid-session.

routes/chat.py:166-184 — POST /api/chat/sessions silently ignores foreign folder_id (returns 200 with folder_id=None). Good for non-leakage, but the UI cannot tell the user 'that folder isn't yours'. Consider a 403 or a `folder_id_ignored: true` flag for future UX clarity. Not a security issue.
routes/chat.py:189-203 — GET /api/chat/sessions?folder_id=<foreign> returns [] (because user_id filter excludes foreign sessions) — clean, but worth a docstring note.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 new tests pass + 16/17 92.23.7 regression — 1 transient network timeout unrelated to 92.23.8)
success_rate.frontend: not tested (backend-only request per main agent)

key_findings: POST /api/chat with foreign folder_id → folder_context_used=False, HTTP 200, no leak ✅
Multi-turn (same session + folder_id) → context still injected on turn 2 ✅
POST /api/chat/sessions with owned folder_id → session.folder_id stamped AND folder_items row of item_type=chat_session inserted, source_id=session_id ✅
POST /api/chat/sessions with foreign folder_id → 200 with folder_id=None, NO folder_item created (no info leak) ✅
GET /api/chat/sessions?folder_id=<owned> → returns only sessions tagged with that folder ✅
GET /api/chat/sessions (no filter) → returns ALL sessions (regression OK) ✅
